lead: A playbook bullet edited by hand leaves its record under `data/playbook/` stale, and `bun nv import --check` crashes before it reaches the playbook.
body: The import runs every importer, and `tools/nv/import/rules.ts` still reads `docs/rules/_index.json`, which is gone, while `bun nv playbook --check` never compares a bullet with its record. Re-import the bullets alone from a scratch script under `.agent-tmp/` that calls `playbook.read(ROOT)` from `tools/nv/import/playbook.ts` and `write` from `tools/nv/lib/store.ts`.
